versions.content: When callback notification CanIf_TxConfirma- tion() is called, CanIf shall identify the upper layer communication layer (see [SWS_CANIF_00414]), which is linked to the successfully transmitted L-PDU , and shall notify it about the performed transmission by call of CanIf 's transmit confirmation service <User_TxConfirmation>(E_OK) .
